title.zh: 扎克伯格联手哈萨比斯：18亿美元攻关「虚拟细胞」
title.en: 扎克伯格联手哈萨比斯：18亿美元攻关「虚拟细胞」

current_state.zh: Zuckerberg-backed Biohub expanded its Virtual Biology Initiative to roughly $1.8B with Google DeepMind, Meta, and Isomorphic Labs joining to build AI models that predict live-cell responses for drug discovery, backed by US DOE funding and NIH data.
current_state.en: Zuckerberg-backed Biohub expanded its Virtual Biology Initiative to roughly $1.8B with Google DeepMind, Meta, and Isomorphic Labs joining to build AI models that predict live-cell responses for drug discovery, backed by US DOE funding and NIH data.
